blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Unified autoregressive (AR) image generators struggle to satisfy multiple attribute constraints in a single prompt. Although these attributes are decodable from image-token latents, editing those latents at test time remains difficult. Adding a fixed attribute direction to the prefix can reinforce a requested attribute but rarely overrides a conflicting one, such as turning a car red when the prompt specifies blue. We investigate how the effect of an intervention depends on where it acts in the image-token sequence. We introduce the causal support profile, which measures, for each attribute, how often patching image-token states within a given window flips the rendered attribute. Structural attributes (count and position) are most responsive in early, narrow windows, while appearance attributes (color, size, and material) respond over later, broader windows. A budget-matched comparison of early and middle windows shows that the effect of window location depends on the target attribute, and two-dimensional support maps show that the responsive regions track spatial content. Based on these profiles, we propose LOCUS (Latent Optimization in Causal Support windows), which diagnoses which attribute failed and routes test-time latent optimization to its corresponding support window. With the generator, optimizer, reward, verifier, and token budget held fixed, support-routed windows outperform late windows by 23.6 percentage points in GenEval++ macro accuracy. With the generator frozen, LOCUS raises Janus-Pro's GenEval++ accuracy from 24.6% to 46.8% overall and from 19.5% to 40.5% on multi-attribute tags. On GenEval, LOCUS repairs 48.1% of failed generations in one rollout, compared with 37.4% for prefix optimization, and needs 14% fewer rounds on average to succeed.
blocks.zh: 统一的自递(AR)图像生成器在单个快取中拼搏来满足多个属性限制. 虽然这些属性可以从图像刻入的潜想中解码,但在测试时编辑这些潜想仍然很困难. 在前缀上添加固定的属性方向可以强化所请求的属性,但很少会凌驾于相冲突的属性上,例如当提示指定为蓝色时会将一辆车变成红色. 我们调查干预的效果如何取决于它在图像存储序列中的行动。 我们引入了因果支持配置, 用于衡量每个属性, 在特定窗口中多频繁地对图像键状态进行补丁, 翻转给定属性 。 结构属性(计数和位置)在早期,狭小的窗口中反应最快,而外观属性(颜色,大小,和材料)在后期,更宽的窗口中反应最快. 对早期和中间窗口的预算相匹配的比较表明,窗口位置的效果取决于目标属性,二维支持地图显示反应区域跟踪空间内容. 基于这些配置,我们提议LOCUS(Causal支持窗口中的Latent Optestization),该选项诊断哪些是失败的属性,并引导测试时间潜在优化到相应的支持窗口. 在GenEval++宏准确度中,由于生成器、优化器、奖励、核查器和象征性预算被固定,支持路由窗口比后期窗口高出23.6%。 随着发电机被冻结,LOCUS将Janus-Pro的GenEval++精度从24.6%整体提升到46.8%,并在多属性标签上从19.5%提升到40.5%. 在"GenEval"上,LOCUS在一次推出中修复了48.1%的失败世代,而前缀优化则需要37.4%,并且平均需要减少14%的回合才能成功.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Autoregressive (AR) image generators such as LlamaGen [ 42 ] and Emu3 [ 49 ] emit an image as a sequence of discrete tokens, and unified models such as Janus-Pro [ 10 ] now understand and generate images with a single AR backbone.
Yet these models still get object attributes wrong, and most often on compositional prompts that bind several of them at once [ 35 , 22 , 3 , 24 ] (Figure 1 a). Appearance attributes ( color , size , material ) describe how a single object looks; structural attributes ( count , position ) describe how objects are laid out in the scene; a compositional prompt such as “three red apples” mixes the two.
On GenEval++ [ 54 ] , Janus-Pro scores 37.5% on the single-attribute tags (Color, Count) but 19.5% on the five multi-attribute tags, such as Color/Count and Pos/Size.
These are the failures a test-time repair should fix without retraining.
blocks.zh:
自动回转(AR)图像生成器,如LlamaGen [42]和Emu3 [49] 发射出一幅图像作为离散符号的序列,而Janus-Pro [10] 等统一模型现在用单一的AR主干来理解并生成图像.
然而,这些模型仍然使对象属性有误,而且最经常的是在组合的提示上,这些提示一并绑定了其中的几个[35、22、3、24](图1a)。 外观属性(颜色,大小,材质. )描述单个物体的外观;结构属性(计数,位置. )描述物体在场景中的布局;"三个红苹果"等组成快板将两者相混合.
在GenEval++ [54]上,Janus-Pro在单属性标签(Color, Counter)上得分为37.5%,但在多属性标签上得分为19.5%,如Color/Count和Pos/Size.
这些是失败,试验时间的修理应该不用再培训就解决。

blocks.en:
Figure 1 : Motivation of LOCUS. (a) AR generators often get object attributes wrong, such as color, size, material, count, and position, especially when a prompt combines them.
(b) Prefix-optimization and direction-steering methods edit only the earliest latents and can miss attributes whose support window lies later, such as appearance, while (c) LOCUS diagnoses the failed attribute and optimizes only the latents in its support window.
blocks.zh:
图1:本地企业的动机。 (a) AR生成器往往会错误地得到对象属性,如颜色、大小、材料、计数和位置,特别是当一个提示将其结合时。
(b) 前缀优化和取向方法只编辑最早的后缀,并可能漏掉其后缀支持窗口的属性,如外观等;同时(c) LOCUS诊断失败属性并优化其后缀窗口中的后缀.

blocks.en:
These models do encode the attributes.
A linear probe [ 1 ] reads an object’s color from the image-token latents with 67.1% accuracy (chance: 10%), and a sparse autoencoder [ 11 , 5 ] recovers 148 monosemantic color features.
Steering the prefix latents along the probe direction, however, amplifies a color the prompt already requests, yet overrides a conflicting one (e.g., a blue car edited toward red) in only 26.7% of trials, on par with a random direction (§ 3.2 ).
The attribute is readable but not freely steerable; we call this the readability–steerability gap , consistent with evidence that decodability does not imply causal use [ 13 , 2 ] .
blocks.zh:
这些模型确实编码了属性.
线性探测器 [1] 读取一个物体的颜色, 其精度为67.1% (chance: 10 %), 和一个稀疏的自定义编码器 [11, 5] 恢复了148个单一语义的颜色特征。
然而,沿着探测器方向引导前缀潜伏,会放大一个已经请求的颜色,但是在只有26.7%的试验中,将一个相冲突的颜色(如被编辑成红色的蓝色汽车)凌驾于一个随机方向之上(第3.2节)。
属性是可读的,但不能自由引导;我们称之为可读性-可读性差距,这与可解码并不意味着因果使用的证据一致 [13, 2].

blocks.en:
Test-time control methods inherit this gap.
Latent optimization tunes image-token latents against a reward [ 36 , 29 ] , and representation steering adds a fixed concept direction to the hidden states [ 30 ] ; both work for some attributes and fail for others, with no account of which.
Neither treats where along the trajectory it intervenes as a variable: each acts at one location whichever attribute failed (Figure 1 b).
This matters most for compositional prompts, where the failed attribute may be a count in one image and a color in the next.
AR decoding commits the image one token at a time and freezes each state in the KV-cache, so each attribute may stay changeable only within its own window of the sequence.
We ask: when and where along the AR trajectory does each object attribute become causally steerable?
blocks.zh:
试验时间控制方法继承了这一空白.
Latent 优化调用图像-token 潜想来对抗奖励 [36, 29], 代表方向为隐藏状态添加了固定的概念方向 [30] ;两者都为一些属性工作,对另一些属性则失败,没有说明.
也不将沿轨迹所干预之处视为可变因素:每个行为在一个地点,以失败的属性为准(图1b)。
这对组成提示最为重要,其中失败的属性可能是一个图像中的计数和下一个图像中的颜色.
AR解码一次将图像一个符号接入并冻结了KV-cache中的每个状态,因此每个属性可能只可以在序列的自有窗口内被改变.
我们问:在AR轨迹沿线,每个物体的属性何时何地可因果地转向?

blocks.en:
To answer it, we introduce the causal support profile C a ​ ( W ) C_{a}(W) : given two prompts that differ only in attribute a a , the rate at which copying the image-token states in window W W from one run into the other flips the rendered attribute (§ 3.1 ).
Patching the full trajectory at any single layer suffices to flip color, so control is indexed by decode step, not by layer.
Across attributes, the profiles fall into two regimes: structural attributes commit early and narrowly, while appearance attributes commit later, over the object body, and barely respond to prefix edits.
The two attributes of a compositional prompt are therefore decided at different points of the sequence, and an intervention fixed at one location can reach failures of one kind but not the other.
The split is consistent with the one-directional information flow of the causal mask and KV-cache, and it suggests a testable hypothesis: a test-time repair succeeds only when the intervention overlaps the failed attribute’s support window .
blocks.zh:
为了回答这个问题,我们介绍了因果支持简介Ca (W) C_{a}(W): 给出了两个仅在属性 a 上有差异的提示,在窗口 W W 中将图像键状态从一个运行到另一个运行的速度翻转已显示的属性(§ 3.1)。
在任何一地层上补上完整的轨迹都足以翻转颜色,所以控制通过解码步骤而不是层来索引.
纵观属性,剖面分为两种制度:结构属性早期和狭义地承诺,而外观属性晚期则在对象体上承诺,对前缀编辑几乎没有反应.
因此,组合快取的两个属性在序列的不同点决定,固定在一个地点的干预可以达到一种但不能达到另一种失败.
分拆符合因果口罩和KV-cache的一向信息流,它提出了一个可以验证的假设:只有当干预与失败属性的支持窗口重叠时,测试时间修复才会成功.

blocks.en:
LOCUS ( L atent O ptimization in C a u sal S upport windows) turns this hypothesis into a repair method.
It diagnoses the failed attribute and routes test-time latent optimization [ 36 ] to that attribute’s support window instead of always to the prefix (Figure 1 c).
The same profiles explain the mixed record of prefix optimization, whose window contains the support of structural attributes and misses that of appearance attributes.
With the token budget, optimizer, reward, and verifier fixed, support-routed windows score 23.6 percentage points higher than late windows on GenEval++.
The margin over prefix optimization is largest where the profiles predict it: on the multi-attribute tags that pair a structural with an appearance attribute, LOCUS reaches 45.0%, against 38.3% for the prefix and 21.7% for the late window.
In a blind sweep that ignores the profiles, repair success still rises with support overlap (§ 4 ).
The advantage holds under a second verifier [ 39 ] (§ 4.3 ), the support follows spatial content rather than raster order and transfers to held-out objects (§ 3.2 ), and the structure-before-appearance order recurs on LlamaGen-XL and Lumina-mGPT 2.0.
We make three contributions: • We define the causal support profile of each attribute and measure it by cross-prompt patching, localizing control along the generation sequence rather than network depth. • We show that structural attributes commit early and narrowly and appearance attributes later and broadly, that this order recurs on two more AR models, and that support overlap predicts repair success at a fixed budget. • We propose LOCUS, which routes test-time latent optimization to the support window of each failed attribute. With the generator frozen, it raises Janus-Pro’s GenEval++ accuracy from 24.6% to 46.8% and, on GenEval [ 17 ] , improves single-rollout repair success over prefix optimization by 10.7 percentage points (§ 4.4 ).
blocks.zh:
LOCUS(在 C a u sal S upport 窗口中的 Latent O pimization)将这个假说变成了一种修复方法.
它诊断失败的属性以及测试时间潜在优化 [36] 到该属性的支持窗口而不是总是到前缀(图1 c).
相同的剖面图解释了前缀优化的混合记录,其窗口包含结构属性的支持并忽略了外观属性.
有了符号预算,在GenEval++上,优化器,奖励和验证器固定,支持路由窗口比后期窗口高23.6个百分点.
前缀优化的比值在配置预测时最大:在将结构与外观属性相配的多属性标记上,LOCUS达到45.0%,而前缀为38.3%,后窗为21.7%.
在无视概况的盲目扫荡中,修复成功仍然随着支持重叠而上升(§4).
这一优势在第二个核查者[39](§ 4.3)之下,支持遵循空间内容而不是光栅顺序,并向被搁置物体转移(§ 3.2),在LlamaGen-XL和Lumina-mGPT 2.0上,结构-出现前命令反复出现。
• 我们作出三项贡献: 我们定义每个属性的因果支持剖面,并通过交叉即时补丁,按照生成序列定位控制而不是网络深度来衡量. ^ 我们显示,结构属性在早期和狭义上承诺,在后期和广义上都具有外观属性,这一顺序在另外两个AR模型上重复出现,而支持的重叠预示着固定预算的修复成功. • 我们提议LOCUS,它将测试时间潜在优化到每个失败属性的支持窗口. 随着发电机被冻结,它将Janus-Pro的GenEval++精度从24.6%提升至46.8%,并在GenEval [17]上将单滚出修复成功率提升至10.7个百分点(§ 4.4).

blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

图2: LOCUS概览. § 3.1 测量因果支持 C a (W) C_{a} (W) 通过交叉瞬间活化补丁:捐赠者隐藏状态通过窗口 W W 替换接收者,而翻转率是支持.

blocks.en:
Autoregressive and unified image generators. Token-based image models cast pixels as discrete visual tokens [ 46 , 15 ] and emit them autoregressively, as in LlamaGen [ 42 ] , Emu3 [ 49 ] , Chameleon [ 6 ] , Lumina-mGPT [ 32 ] , and next-scale variants such as VAR [ 43 ] ; unified models extend the same backbone to image understanding [ 10 , 52 , 53 , 12 , 51 , 50 ] .
Each image token is conditioned on the prompt and on all previous tokens, so an attribute could in principle be decided anywhere along the sequence; where it is decided has not been measured.
blocks.zh:
自动回放并统一图像生成器. 基于Token的图像模型将像素铸成离散的视觉符号[46,15]并自动地放出,如LlamaGen [42],Emu3 [49],Chameleon [6],Lumina-mGPT [32]等下级变体;统一的模型将相同的骨干扩展到图像理解[10,52,53,12,51,50].
每个图像符号都以即时和所有前作符号为条件,因此一个属性原则上可以按照序列在任何地方决定;在决定的地方没有测量.

blocks.en:
Test-time control of AR image generators. MILR [ 36 ] adapts LatentSeek [ 29 ] to text-to-image generation and optimizes prefix image-token latents by policy gradient against a reward.
TwiG [ 18 ] inserts textual thoughts at predefined decoding spans, LatentMorph [ 9 ] learns when to trigger latent reasoning, ScalingAR [ 8 ] schedules guidance with visual-token entropy, and other schemes prune or anchor partial decodes [ 38 ] or plan and refine around generation [ 16 ] .
These methods use fixed or learned schedules, or treat the trajectory as one block; none identifies which image-token states are causally responsible for a given attribute.
LOCUS keeps an existing optimizer, adds no schedule, and places the optimization inside the measured support of the failed attribute.
LAC [ 55 ] observes that understanding need not imply controllable generation; our measurements make it testable: control fails when the intervention misses the support window.
blocks.zh:
AR图像生成器的试验时间控制. MILR [36] 适应LatentSeek [29] 的文本到图像生成,并通过政策梯度与奖励来优化前缀图像-token的潜想.
TwiG [18] 在预定义的解码跨度上插入文字思维,LatentMorph [9] 学会何时触发潜在推理,用可视取键来扩展AR [8] 调度指导,以及其他方案 prune或锚定部分解码 [38] 或规划和完善周围的生成 [16] 。
这些方法使用固定的或学到的时间表,或者把轨迹当作一个块处理;没有一种方法可以确定哪些被图像刻录的状态对某一属性负有因果关系。
LOCUS 保留一个已存在的优化器,不添加调度,并将优化放入失败属性的测量支持.
LAC [55] 指出,理解不一定意味着可控制生成;我们的测量使其具有可测试性:当干预错过支持窗口时控制失败.

blocks.en:
Temporal structure in diffusion generation. Diffusion control often acts at selected denoising timesteps [ 33 , 19 , 7 ] , and theory formalizes critical windows in which specific features emerge [ 31 ] .
Sparse-autoencoder studies find that scene composition is fixed in early denoising steps while style and texture remain editable later [ 44 , 23 ] .
Our structure-early, appearance-late profile mirrors this pattern on a different axis: AR image tokens follow a spatial order, are carried through a KV-cache, and re-read the prompt at every step, so the support we study is a region of the token trajectory, not of a noise schedule.
blocks.zh:
扩散生成中的时间结构。 分泌控制往往在选定的去诺时间步[33,19,7]中起作用,而理论则将出现具体特征的关键窗口正规化[31].
Sparse-autoencoder研究发现,场景成分固定在早期去诺步骤中,而样式和纹理则在后期仍然可以编辑 [44, 23].
我们的结构-ear,外观-late profile在不同的轴上反射出这种图案: AR图像符遵循空间顺序,通过KV-cache来携带,并在每一步重读提示符,因此我们研究的支持是符号轨迹的区域,而不是噪音表.

blocks.en:
Causal interpretability and representation steering. Activation patching and causal mediation localize the components behind a behavior by transplanting activations between runs [ 34 , 56 , 47 , 48 ] .
Probes [ 1 ] and sparse autoencoders [ 11 , 5 ] show that concepts can be linearly readable, but probe accuracy can be spurious [ 20 ] and decodable information can be removed without changing behavior [ 13 ] , so surveys advocate intervention-based claims [ 2 ] .
Representation engineering adds fixed concept directions to hidden states [ 30 , 45 , 41 , 60 ] , and sparse-feature steering has carried this to image generators [ 27 ] .
We bring this causal stance to the AR image-token trajectory and ask when and where an encoded attribute becomes usable for control; the answer accounts for the readability–steerability gap, in which a readable direction amplifies an attribute yet fails to override a conflicting prompt.
blocks.zh:
因果关系和代表性指导。 激活补丁和因果调解通过在跑道之间移植激活使行为背后的组件本地化[34,56,47,48].
探测器 [1]和稀有自定义编码器 [11,5] 显示概念可以线性可读取,但探测精度可以作假 [20] 并可以去除可解码的信息而不改变行为 [13],因此调查主张基于干预的主张 [2].
代表工程在隐藏状态中增加了固定的概念方向[30,45,41,60],而零星的地平面向导将它带入了图像生成器[27].
我们把这种因果姿态带到AR 图像接通轨迹, 并询问编码属性何时何地可用于控制; 答案说明可读性-可读性差距, 其中可读性方向放大了一个属性, 却未能覆盖一个相冲突的快取。

blocks.en: 3 Method: From Causal Support to LOCUS
blocks.zh: 3 方法:从因果支持到当地支助

blocks.en:
LOCUS is built on a measurement of where along the image-token trajectory an attribute can still be changed (Figure 2 ).
We define this measurement (§ 3.1 ), use it to locate a support window for each attribute (§ 3.2 ), and route test-time repair to these windows (§ 3.3 ).
blocks.zh:
LOCUS是建立在测量一个仍然可以改变一个属性的图像基轨迹的位置之上的(图2)。
我们定义了这个测量(§ 3.1),用它定位每个属性的辅助窗口(§ 3.2),以及对这些窗口的路由测试时间修复(§ 3.3).

blocks.en:
Cross-prompt activation patching. We use minimal pairs of prompts that differ in one attribute word, such as “a red car” and “a blue car”.
We cache the per-layer residual hidden state of a donor generation, write it into the receiver over a layer L L and a step window W W , and record whether the rendered attribute of the receiver flips to that of the donor.
For color, the pairs swap blue ↔ \leftrightarrow red over five objects, giving six directed pairs; the other attributes use analogous sets.
The layer sweep covers layers 0, 6, 12, 18, 24, and 29, and the window grid includes 11- and 64-step prefixes, a sliding fixed-width window, early/mid/late thirds, and the whole trajectory. Per-attribute profiles use layer 0.
blocks.zh:
交叉即时激活补丁. 我们使用一个属性词不同的最小对提示,例如“一辆红色汽车”和“一辆蓝色汽车”。
我们缓存一个捐助方一代的每层剩余隐藏状态,将其写入一个LL层和一个阶窗WW的接收器,并记录接收器的属性是否翻转到捐助方的属性.
对于颜色,对子将蓝色 \\\ 左右旋红色相换于5个对象,给出了6个方向对;其他属性使用相类似套.
地层扫描覆盖了地层0,6,12,18,24和29等地,而窗口网格包括了11和64步前缀,一个滑动的固定宽度窗口,早期/中后期/后期三分之一,以及整个轨迹. 属性配置图使用图层 0.

blocks.en:
Causal support profile. For attribute a a and window W W , the causal support profile C a ​ ( W ) C_{a}(W) is the rate at which patching W W flips the receiver’s attribute to the donor’s; we use flip rate and override interchangeably.
We summarize a profile by cross05 , the number of leading tokens patched when the flip rate first reaches 50%. A small value means the attribute commits early, and a large value means it commits late.
Because cross05 is a cumulative-prefix summary, it is biased toward early steps, so we also report sliding fixed-width windows and a two-dimensional spatial analysis (§ 3.2 ), which do not share this bias.
blocks.zh:
原因支持简介. 对于属性 a 和 窗口 W ,因果支持配置 C a (W) C_{a} (W) 是补丁 W W 将接收器的属性翻转给捐赠者的速率; 我们使用翻转速率和可互换的覆接.
我们通过Cross05来总结一个剖面图, 当翻转率第一次达到50%时, 主要符号数被补上。 一个小值表示属性承诺早,一个大值表示它承诺晚.
因为cross05是一个累积前缀摘要,它偏向于早期步骤,所以我们也报告滑动的固定宽度窗口和二维空间分析(§ 3.2),它们并不认同这种偏差.

blocks.en:
Evaluators. CLIP [ 40 ] scores flips of appearance attributes, and GenEval detectors score flips of structural ones.
Because a pure-color frame trivially passes a color check, appearance flips are content-gated: a flip counts only if CLIP image–image similarity to the baseline stays within 0.92 × 0.92\times .
blocks.zh:
评价者。 CLIP [40] 分出外观属性的翻转,而GenEval探测器分出结构属性的翻转.
因为一个纯彩相框略微地通过一个色调检查, 外观翻转是用内容表示的: 翻转只有在 CLIP 图像 — 图像与基线的相近性停留在 0.92 × 0.92\时间之内时才算数 。

blocks.en: 3.2 Localizing causal support windows
blocks.zh: 3.2 将因果支持窗口定位

blocks.en:
We first locate the readability–steerability gap at the prefix, then show that sequence coverage rather than layer limits control, and finally show that the support window depends on the attribute, is spatial, and predicts which edits succeed.
The output is a support window W a W_{a} for each attribute class, which LOCUS reads at test time.
blocks.zh:
我们首先在前缀找到可读性-steerable差距,然后显示序列覆盖而不是层限制控制,最后显示支持窗口依赖于属性,是空间,并预测哪个编辑成功.
输出为每个属性类的辅助窗口W a W_{a},LOCUS在测试时读取.

blocks.en:
Readable, but not steerable at the prefix. We take color as a running example (Table 1 ).
A linear probe [ 1 ] predicts the rendered color from image-token latents with 67.1% accuracy.
A 256-unit sparse autoencoder (SAE) reconstructs the latents with a fraction of variance unexplained (FVU) of 0.037 and learns 148 monosemantic color features [ 5 ] that cover all ten colors (Figure 3 ).
Yet a fixed color direction added to the prefix latents overrides a conflicting prompt in only 26.7% of trials, on par with a random direction, whereas the same direction applied across the full trajectory overrides it in nearly all trials.
At the prefix, the direction thus amplifies a color the prompt already requests but rarely overrides one it contradicts.
blocks.zh:
可读,但前缀不能被引导 。 我们把颜色作为运行中的例子(表1)。
线性探测器 [1] 以67.1%的精度预测出从图像堆潜出而成的颜色.
256个单元的稀疏自编码器(SAE)以0.037的微分差异(FVU)来重建潜伏体,并学习了148个涵盖所有10个颜色的单语义色彩特征[5](图3.
然而,在前缀中添加一个固定的颜色取向,在只有26.7%的试验中,与随机取向完全相同,而几乎在所有试验中,整个轨迹所适用的同一取向都超过这个取向。
在前缀中, 方向因此放大了已请求的颜色, 但很少超过它与之相矛盾的颜色 。

blocks.en: Figure 3 : Color is cleanly readable from the latents. SAE color-selective features are block-diagonal by preferred color, and the 148 recovered features together cover all ten colors.
blocks.zh: 图3:颜色从潜入物中可以清晰地读取。 SAE色彩选择特征以首选颜色为块-对角,148所恢复的特征一起覆盖了所有十种颜色.

blocks.en: Table 1 : The readability–steerability gap for color (Janus-Pro). Prefix override matches a random-direction control.
blocks.zh: 表1:颜色的可读性-可变性差距(Janus-Pro. 前缀比对随机方向控制 。

blocks.en: Takeaway. Readability does not imply steerability: the same color direction fails at the prefix but succeeds across the trajectory, so location matters.
blocks.zh: 外卖 可读性并不意味着可导性:前缀的同色取向失败而成功跨越了轨迹,所以位置很重要.

blocks.en:
Sequence coverage, not layer, is the bottleneck. The prefix failure could reflect the wrong layer or too little coverage of the sequence, and a layer × \times window sweep on color pairs separates the two (Figure 4 ).
Patching only the first 11 or 64 steps almost never flips the color at any layer, whereas patching the whole trajectory flips it at every single layer (Figure 4 c).
The flip rate reaches 50% after the first 144 steps, a quarter of the sequence (Figure 4 b), and a sliding window shows that the block over the object body flips color most often and the last rows least often (Figure 4 a).
A wrong-attribute donor or a wrong window flips almost nothing (appendix), so the effect is attribute-specific.
blocks.zh:
序列覆盖,不是分层,是瓶颈. 前缀失败可能反映错层或对序列的覆盖太少,而一层×\times窗口在相色对上扫描将两者相分离(图4).
只补丁前11或前64个步骤几乎从不翻转任何一层的颜色,而补丁整个轨迹则在每一层翻转(图4 c).
翻转速率在前144步后达到50%,为顺序的四分之一(图4b),一个滑动窗口显示,在物体正体上方的块翻转多为颜色,而后一行最不常见(图4a).
错误的属性捐赠者或错误的窗口翻转几乎一无所获(附录),所以效果是属性特定的.

(a) Flip rate of each block (bars) and CLIP color margin (dashed, right axis).
(b) Flip rate and margin versus contiguous prefix coverage.

(b) 翻转率和比值相对于相接的前缀覆盖。

blocks.en: Takeaway. Control is indexed by decode step, not by layer, and for color the prefix is the window that fails.
blocks.zh: 外卖 控制按解码步骤而不是分层索引,而对于颜色,前缀是失败的窗口.

blocks.en:
The support window depends on the attribute. Extending the measurement to five attributes separates two regimes (Figure 5 a,b).
Structural attributes ( count , position ) commit early and narrowly: their flip rates reach 50% at 48 and 84 steps, and the first 144 steps suffice to override them.
Appearance attributes ( color , size , material ) reach 50% only at 163–232 steps; the middle window (steps 144–288, over the object body) is the most effective, and prefix override is near zero.
A 13-attribute spectrum in the appendix places further attributes on the same early → \to late axis.
The split is not specific to Janus-Pro: on LlamaGen-XL (256 tokens, T5 conditioning), position reaches 50% after 6% of the sequence (95% CI, 16–32 tokens), whereas color and material need 25% and 50%, and a 16-token prefix flips position in 50% of pairs but color in only 7%; Lumina-mGPT 2.0 shows the same order (appendix).
Real generations show the same split (Figure 6 ).
A prefix color patch tints the background but leaves the object in the prompted color, and a prefix size patch leaves the object small, whereas for count and position the early window already overrides the attribute.
blocks.zh:
支持窗口取决于属性. 将测量范围扩大到五个属性将两个制度分开(图5 a,b)。
结构属性(计数,位置) 早期和狭义承诺:它们的翻转速率在48和84步达到50%,而前144步足以压倒它们.
外观属性(颜色,大小,材质等)仅在163–232个步骤上达到50%;中间窗口(步数为144–288,凌驾于物体正体之上)最为有效,而前缀覆接也接近于零.
附录中的13个属性谱会进一步将属性放置在同一早期 ~\到后轴上.
分出不特指Janus-Pro:在LlamaGen-XL上(256个令牌,T5调制),位置在序列的6%后达到50%(95% CI,16–32个令牌),而颜色和材料需要25%和50%,而16个托肯前缀在50%对上但只有7%的颜色上倒出位置;Lumina-mGPT 2.0显示相同的顺序(附录).
活生生的世代呈现出相同的分化(图6).
前缀颜色补丁将背景标出,但将对象留在所提示的颜色中,而前缀大小补丁则会使对象小,而对于计数和定位,早期窗口已经覆盖了属性.

blocks.en:
Support is spatial, not a raster artifact. Because Janus-Pro decodes in raster order, “color commits at step K K ” could merely restate “the object’s pixels decode at step K K ”; this reading predicts support on the last-decoded bottom rows.
We place the same object at the top, center, or bottom of the image and patch one four-row band at a time over eight objects (Figure 7 ).
Single-band patches flip color in 37% of pairs at rows 4–8 and 32% at rows 8–12, but never at rows 16–24, and the necessity peak shifts downward as the object moves from top to center: the support follows the object.
blocks.zh:
支持是空间的,不是光栅文物. 因为 Janus-Pro 按光栅顺序解码, “ 彩色在步骤 K K 中承诺 ” 只能重复“ 对象的像素在步骤 K K 中解码 ” ; 这种读取预言了最后被解码的下行的支持 。
我们在图像的上,中,或下方放置同一种物体,并补上一个四行相带一次超过8个物体(图7 ).
单波段补丁以第4-8行对数的37%和第8-12行对数的32%来翻转颜色,但第16-24行从未翻转过,随着对象从上到下移动,必要性峰值会向下移动:支持会跟随对象.

(b) Flip rate of each 144-step block.

blocks.en:
The support window is predictive. Patching shows that a window is sufficient , but under a generic-coverage account, in which any large enough window overrides any attribute, window location would carry no information.
A pre-specified 2 × 2 2\times 2 design tests this account (Figure 5 c).
We cross attribute class (structure: position , count ; appearance: color , size ) with two budget-matched 144-step bands at layer 0: the early band over the image top (steps 0–144) and the middle band over the object body (steps 144–288).
If location matters, moving from the early to the middle band should help appearance but not structure.
The move raises the appearance flip rate from 29% to 58% and lowers the structure flip rate from 62% to 52%, an interaction of 39 points (95% CI, 1–78 points; one-sided bootstrap p = 0.02 p=0.02 over 5,000 resamples with 10–12 clean pairs per attribute).
The window also transfers beyond the pairs used to calibrate it: applied to 38 held-out objects with held-out colors, the color window flips 34.2% of them, whereas an equal-length late window flips none ( p = 0.0002 p=0.0002 ; appendix).
blocks.zh:
支持窗口具有预测性. 补丁显示窗口已经足够, 但是在一个通用覆盖账户下, 任何大的窗口都会覆盖任何属性, 窗口位置不会包含任何信息 。
预先指定的 2×2 2\times 2设计测试此账户(图5 c).
我们跨越属性类(结构:位置;计数;外观:颜色;大小),0层有两个预算相匹配的144步波段:早期波段在图像上方(步骤0–144),中间波段在物体体上方(步骤144–288)。
如果位置重要,从早期转向中间波段应有助于外观,而不利于结构.
这一动作将外观翻转率从29%提升到58%,并将结构翻转率从62%降低到52%,相互作用为39分(95%的CI,1–78分;单侧靴子p=0.02,每对属性为10–12个清洁对).
窗口也转出用于校正的对子:被应用到38个有被拖出颜色的被拖出的对象上,彩色窗口翻出其中34.2%,而等长的后窗翻出无(p = 0.0002 p = 0.0002;附录).

blocks.en:
Takeaway. No single window serves every attribute.
The prefix covers structural support but misses appearance support, and the mid band does the reverse.
blocks.zh:
外卖 没有单一窗口为每个属性服务 。
前缀覆盖了结构支持,但错过了外观支持,中段则进行倒置.

blocks.en: 3.3 LOCUS: support-routed latent repair
blocks.zh: 3.3 现场协调:支持式潜在修理

blocks.en:
From findings to design. Because control depends on which steps an edit covers and not on the layer, LOCUS keeps the intervention target of test-time latent optimization, the image-token latents [ 36 ] , and varies only which steps it optimizes.
Because no single window serves every attribute, it first identifies which attribute failed and then intervenes on that attribute’s window.

The window shape follows an account of how information moves through the generator; the account is consistent with the profiles, although we do not measure attention directly.
The causal mask and KV-cache make the flow one-directional: a state written early is read by every later step, and a later state cannot revise it.
A spatial layout is therefore fixed once in the early states, and a sparse early window would leave gaps in which the rollout re-asserts the old layout, so position failures use a contiguous early block.
Appearance is instead re-read from the attribute word as each object region is decoded, so a budget subsampled evenly across the appearance window overlaps more of these reading steps than a contiguous block of the same size.
blocks.zh:
从发现到设计 由于控制取决于编辑覆盖的哪个步骤而不是地层,LOCUS保留了测试时潜在优化的干预目标,即图像-token潜在 [36],并且只不同其优化的哪个步骤.
因为没有一个单一窗口为每个属性服务,它首先识别哪些属性失败,然后干预该属性的窗口.

窗口形状遵循一个信息如何通过生成器移动的描述;该描述与配置一致,尽管我们不直接测量注意.
由因果口罩和KV-cache使流向单向:一个写出早的状态会由后方的每一个步骤来读取,而后方状态不能修改.
因此,空间布局在早期状态中固定了一次,一个稀少的早期窗口会留下空白,其中推出会重新注入旧的布局,因此位置故障使用相接的早期块.
外观取而代之的是从属性字被重新读取,因为每个对象区域被解码出,所以一个平平地在外观窗口上被分镜的预算会比一个大小相同的相接块重叠更多的这些读取步骤.

blocks.en:
Repair loop. Given a prompt, a frozen AR generator, a verifier, and the profiles { C a } \{C_{a}\} , LOCUS repairs a failed base generation in rounds of four steps (Figure 2 ).
(1) Diagnose : the verifier returns the set F F of failed attribute dimensions, such as count or color.
(2) Route : each a ∈ F a\in F is mapped to its window W a W_{a} read from C a C_{a} , and the union ⋃ a ∈ F W a \bigcup_{a\in F}W_{a} is subsampled evenly to a fixed token budget. Position failures use a contiguous early block, and a failure with no flagged dimension falls back to the prefix.
(3) Optimize : REINFORCE latent optimization [ 36 ] updates only the latents inside the routed window, with the prefix and suffix frozen.
(4) Re-roll : the generator decodes a new image from the optimized latents, and the verifier checks it again.
The loop stops when the verifier accepts the image or after N N rounds.
Prefix optimization acts on the same leading tokens whichever attribute failed, so it helps only when the support of that attribute overlaps the prefix, as for structure but not for appearance.
LOCUS instead spends the budget on tokens that can still change the failed attribute (implementation details are in the appendix).
blocks.zh:
修补回路. 由于一个即时,一个被冷冻的AR生成器,一个验证器,以及配置 {C a } {C_{a}\}} , LOCUS 以四个步骤(图2)来修复一个失败的基元生成.
(1)诊断:核查者返回失败属性维度的集合F F,如计数或颜色.
(2) 路线:每名F a\in F被绘制到它的窗口W a W_{a}从C a C_{a}读取,而工会的QQ F W a\ bigcup\a\ in F}W_{a}被以一个固定的符号预算进行均匀的抽样。 位置失败使用相接的早期块,无标记维度的失败会回落到前缀.
(3)优化:REINFORCE潜伏优化 [36]仅更新路由窗口内的潜伏,并冻结前缀和后缀.
(4)再回卷:生成器从被优化的潜伏物中解码出一出新图像,核查者再次检查.
循环在核查者接受图像或N N回合后停止.
前缀优化是在同一主符上进行,而无论属性失败与否,因此只有在该属性的支持与前缀相重叠时才会有所帮助,对于结构而言,而不是对于外观而言.
LOCUS转而将预算花在仍然可以改变失败属性的符号上(执行细节在附录中).

We test whether routing to the support windows repairs failures that the same intervention placed elsewhere cannot.
After the main comparison (§ 4.2 ), we move the same budget to other windows (§ 4.3 ) and analyze compositional prompts, repair efficiency, and the link between support overlap and repair success (§ 4.4 ).

在主要比较(§4.2)之后,我们把同样的预算转移到其他窗口(§4.3),并分析组成提示、修理效率以及支助重叠与修理成功之间的联系(§4.4)。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
Compositional prompts are where autoregressive image generators fail most, and we asked where along the generation each of their attributes can still be changed.
Cross-prompt patching gives each attribute a causal support profile over the image-token sequence.
Count and position are fixed within the first quarter of the sequence, whereas color, size, and material are decided later, as the object body is decoded, and this support follows where the object sits in the token grid rather than raster order.
This placement accounts for the readability–steerability gap and for why prefix optimization repairs some failures and misses others.
LOCUS uses the measured profiles to decide which latents to optimize at test time.
With the generator frozen, it raises Janus-Pro’s GenEval++ accuracy from 24.6% to 46.8%, and under the same budget it outperforms windows placed elsewhere in the sequence; even when windows are placed without the profiles, repair success rises with support overlap.
The profiles are currently measured offline for a fixed set of attributes; estimating them per prompt is left to future work.

组成提示是自动反向图像生成器最失败的地方,我们问,在生成过程中,每一个属性仍然可以在哪里被改变。

随着发电机被冻结,Janus-Pro的GenEval++精度从24.6%提升到46.8%,而在同一预算下,它比其他序列中的窗口要好;即使没有配置的窗口被放置,修复成功也随着支持重叠而上升。

blocks.en: A.2.1 Negative controls
blocks.zh: A.2.1 消极控制

blocks.en:
The coverage effect of main-paper §3.2 is specific to both the attribute and its support window.
Those flips could in principle reflect a generic perturbation, in which any donor activation applied broadly nudges the decoder.
Two negative controls, run on the same six clean color pairs at a single layer ( L = 0 L{=}0 ), rule out this account (Table 5 ).
Replacing the color donor with a size donor ( small ↔ \leftrightarrow large ) over the identical full window never flips the color (0/6).
Using the correct color donor but restricting it to the prefix window also never flips it (0/6).
The matched color donor over the full trajectory, in contrast, flips every pair (6/6).
A donor state therefore overrides an attribute only when it both carries the matching attribute and is applied over that attribute’s support window.
This joint requirement confirms that the effect tracks attribute-specific causal support rather than arbitrary intervention.

blocks.en: A.2.2 A commit-time spectrum across 13 attributes

blocks.en:
Broadening the measurement of main-paper §3.2 to 13 attributes places them on a single early → \to late spectrum (Table 7 ).
Ordered by cross05 (main paper §3.1), structural attributes sit earliest, object-level appearance in the middle, and surface/pose details ( action , expression , wetness ) latest.
This ordering matches the autoregressive progression “lay out, then fill appearance, then finish surface.”
Late-committing attributes have near-zero prefix override, so we expect prefix optimization to struggle with them.

blocks.en: A.2.3 Support is spatial and semantic, not a decode-time artifact
blocks.zh: A.2.3 支持是空间和语义上的,不是解码时的文物

blocks.en:
The profiles in main-paper §3.2 are measured along the decode-step axis, which invites a deflationary objection.
Because Janus-Pro emits tokens in raster order (row = ⌊ t / 24 ⌋ =\lfloor t/24\rfloor ), “color commits at step K K ” could merely restate “the object’s pixels decode at step K K .”
Under that reading, the profile would be a trivial consequence of token ordering rather than an attribute-level causal structure.
We refute this objection directly.
blocks.zh:
主纸第3.2节中的剖面沿解码步骤轴来测量,这会引起通缩异议.
因为 Janus-Pro 按光栅顺序(row = ⌊ t / 24 =\ ldle t/24\rdle ) 发出信号, “ 彩色在 K 步中承诺 ” 只能重复“ 物体的像素在 K 步中解码 ” 。
根据这一解读,简介将是象征性订购的微不足道的后果,而不是属性一级的因果关系结构。
我们直接驳斥这一反对意见。

blocks.en:
To disentangle decode time from image space, we place the same object at three vertical positions (top / center / bottom) and resolve the causal support over (object placement × \times image row-band).
We measure both sufficiency (patch a band → \to does the color flip?) and necessity (leave a band out → \to does the flip rate drop?), averaged over eight objects (main paper, Figure 7).
A pure raster/decode-time artifact makes a sharp prediction: the causal support should sit on the last -decoded tokens, namely the bottom rows.
The measured support does not.
blocks.zh:
为了将解码时间从图像空间中解开,我们将同一个对象放入三个垂直位置(上/中/下)并解决因果支持(对象放置×\times 图像行-波段).
我们既衡量是否足够(标出一个波段 ~ 以便翻出颜色? ) , 也衡量是否必要(留下一个波段 ~ 以便翻出速度下降? ) , 平均在 8 个物体上(主要纸张, 图7)。
纯光栅/解码-时间的文物会做出一个尖锐的预测:因果支持应该坐到最后一个-解码的符上,即下行.
所衡量的支持是没有的。

Patching a single four-row band flips color in 37% of pairs at rows 4–8 and 32% at rows 8–12. Patching rows 16–24 yields no flips.
Necessity, the drop in flip rate when a band is left out of a full-coverage patch, is small on every band because coverage is redundant: any single band is usually dispensable.
Leaving out rows 12–16 causes the largest drop, at 13 percentage points.
The necessity peak also shifts downward as the object moves top → \to center, indicating partial spatial tracking rather than a fixed decode-time band.

Thus, what we called a “commit time” is more precisely a spatial/semantic support region of the token grid.
This finding reframes the profile and removes the most natural confound.
The structure we measure is attribute- and content-driven, not a restatement of raster decode order.
blocks.zh:
因此,我们所称的“承诺时间”更确切地说是一个信号网的空间/语义支持区域。
这个发现重构了剖面图并删除了最自然的困惑.
我们测量的结构是属性和内容驱动的,而不是对光栅解码顺序的重述.

blocks.en: A.2.4 Profiles transfer across objects, evaluators, and models
blocks.zh: A.2.4 跨物体、评估者和模型的简介

blocks.en:
A profile measured in a single setting could still reflect calibration fit, evaluator choice, or model specificity.
We therefore test it under three controls: held-out objects, a unified evaluator, and two further AR models.
These controls complement the second-verifier check on the repair results (§ A.6 ).
blocks.zh:
在一个单一的环境下测量的剖面图仍然可以反映校准适合性、评价者的选择或模型的特异性。
因此,我们在三个控制下对其进行测试:被搁置的物体、统一的评估者和另外两个AR模型。
这些控制措施补充了第二核查者对修理结果的检查(第A.6节)。

blocks.en:
We first test held-out transfer.
If the support window were only the place we tuned, it should not transfer to unseen instances.
We calibrate the color window on one set of minimal pairs and apply it, count-matched, to a held-out pool of 40 disjoint objects paired with held-out colors.
After excluding two objects with an unclean base render, we score n = 38 n{=}38 (Table 9 ).
The predicted window flips the held-out color in 34.2% of cases. The late window patches the same number of steps and yields no flips ( p = 0.0002 p=0.0002 ).
The predicted window versus the other valid windows is a non-significant trend, mirroring the matched-window ordering of main-paper §4.3.
This transfer indicates that the calibrated window behaves as a transferable causal topology rather than a post-hoc lookup.
blocks.zh:
我们第一次测试延期转移
如果支持窗口只是我们调用的地方,那么它不应该转移到看不见的地方。

预测窗口翻转34.2%的被搁置的颜色. 后期的窗口会补上相同的台阶并产生不翻转(p = 0.0002 p = 0.0002).
预测窗口相对于其他有效窗口是一个非重大趋势,反映了正纸第4.3节的相匹配窗口顺序。
这一转会表明被校正的窗口表现为可转移的因果关系地貌而非后热查.

Table 9 : Held-out transfer to disjoint objects. We score 38 of 40 sampled objects and patch 96 tokens in each arm.

blocks.en:
We next test evaluator dependence.
The commit-time profiles read appearance with the CLIP image–text model and structure with GenEval detectors.
The structure-early/appearance-late ordering could therefore in principle be an artifact of using two different judges.
We rule out this artifact by re-judging the same patched images with a single unified vision-language model (VLM; OmniVerifier-7B).
For every clean (pair, window) patch, we ask the VLM one targeted question about the attribute value and recompute the override curve and its cross05 (Table 10 ).
The unified judge reproduces the original ordering: the structural attribute commits earliest ( count cross05 = 120 =120 under both judges), while the appearance attributes commit far later ( color 216, material 208).
The “structure early, appearance late” ordering is thus a property of the model rather than of the evaluator split.
blocks.zh:
我们下一个测试评估员依赖。
承诺时间剖面可读取带有 CLIP 图像的外观 - 文本模型和带有 GenEval 探测器的结构 。
因此,在结构上 -- -- 早期/表面 -- -- 迟到的命令原则上可能是使用两个不同的法官的一件艺术品。
我们通过用单一统一的视觉语言模型(VLM;OmniVerifer-7B)重新判断相同的补丁图像来排除这个文物.
对于每一个干净的(pair, window)补丁, 我们向 VLM 提出一个关于属性值的目标问题,
统一法官复制了原订单:结构属性最先执行(count cross05 = 120 = 120 在两个裁判下),而外观属性则远后执行(color 216,材质 208).
因此,“结构早期、外观迟缓”命令是模型的财产,而不是评估师分拆的财产。

blocks.en:
Table 10 : Unified-evaluator sanity check on the commit profile. We compute cross05 with the original readouts (CLIP for appearance and a detector for structure) and with OmniVerifier-7B, which scores the same patched images. The column n n gives the number of clean pairs.
The structure-before-appearance ordering holds under both judges.

表10:统一评价人员对承诺概况的理智检查。 我们用原始的读出(CLIP用于外观和结构的探测器)和OmniVerifer-7B来计算cross05,后者的分数是相同的补丁图像. n栏给出了干净的对数.

blocks.en:
We then test whether the picture is specific to Janus-Pro.
On LlamaGen-XL, a second AR model with T5-prefix conditioning and T = 256 T{=}256 image tokens, we repeat the cumulative-prefix cross-prompt activation patching of main-paper §3.2.
The test covers one structural and three appearance attributes, with at least 34 clean minimal pairs each (Table 11 ).
Donor and receiver captions have the same number of T5 tokens, and appearance pairs are run in both directions.
A pair is clean only if the unpatched donor and receiver renders read out their own values; patching the whole sequence reproduces the donor image exactly for every item.
Because sequence lengths differ across models, we compare cross05 as a percentage of the sequence length.

测试涵盖一个结构属性和三个外观属性,每个特征至少有34个清洁最小对(表11.

Parentheses give cross05 as a percentage of the sequence. Ovr@16 is the flip rate after patching the first 16 image tokens.

Position reaches a 50% flip rate first, at 16 tokens (6% of the sequence). Its confidence interval, 16–32 tokens, lies below those for color and material.
The two regimes of main-paper §3.2 reappear, with one difference in degree.
As on Janus-Pro, color and material respond weakly to a 16-token prefix, with flip rates of 7% and 10%, respectively.
Unlike on Janus-Pro, position is largely set by the prefix: 16 patched tokens flip half the pairs.
A finer grid places the crossing at 12 tokens (95% CI, 4–24 tokens). A four-token prefix flips 35% of pairs.
On LlamaGen, the structural layout is thus committed at the very start of the sequence, which is the regime where prefix optimization is expected to work.
Size is the one attribute that does not fit cleanly.
Its CLIP small / large readout registers flips in 42% of pairs after 16 steps. The confidence interval for the crossing spans 16–128 tokens.
Under the content-gated override, size moves to cross05 = 128 \texttt{cross05}{=}128 , so we do not rank it against the other appearance attributes.

位置先达到50%的翻转率,在16个符(占序列的6%). 它的置信间隔为16-32个符,位于颜色和材料的下方.
主要文件第3.2节的两种制度重新出现,在程度上存在一种差异。
与Janus-Pro一样,颜色和材料对16个托克前缀反应很弱,翻转率分别为7%和10%.
与"Janus-Pro"不同的是,位置主要由前缀所设置:16个补丁活符翻出半对.
更精细的网格将过道设为12个道具(95% CI,4–24个道具). 四通前缀翻出35%的对相.

blocks.en:
Finally, we probe a third architecture, Lumina-mGPT 2.0, and again recover the within-model dichotomy: structure and appearance are measured on the same model with the same intervention.
Lumina-mGPT 2.0 [ 32 ] is a Chameleon-style [ 6 ] decoder-only transformer whose discrete image tokens live inside the LLM vocabulary and are decoded by a MoVQGAN detokenizer [ 58 ] .
It thus adds a third, independent conditioning/architecture regime alongside Janus-Pro (text-as-tokens with a learned VQ) and LlamaGen (T5-prefix conditioning).
We measure the commit time of color (appearance) and position (structure) on n = 18 n{=}18 pairs per attribute with the same cumulative-prefix cross-prompt activation patching used for Janus-Pro.
Donor activations are transplanted into a receiver run over a growing prefix [ 0 , K ) [0,K) of the T = 9216 T{=}9216 image tokens, and we record the override (flip-to-donor) rate versus K K (Figure 10 ).
Structure commits before appearance.
Position reaches a 50% flip rate at 3,072 tokens (33% of the sequence) and saturates there. Color reaches 50% at 4,608 tokens (half the sequence) and saturates at 75% coverage.
At every prefix length, the flip rate for position is at least as high as that for color. The swap margins are about 0.10–0.15 for position and 0.03–0.06 for color.
blocks.zh:
最后,我们探索了第三个建筑"Lumina-mGPT 2.0",并再次恢复了模型内部的二分法:结构和外观是用相同的干预在同一个模型上测量的.
Lumina-mGPT 2.0 [32] 是一个变相器风格的 [6] 解码器-只变相器,其离散图像符号活于LLM词汇中,由MoVQGAN解码器解码 [58].
因此,它与Janus-Pro(有学识的VQ的正文)和LlamaGen(T5-前缀)一起增加了第三种独立的条件/建筑制度。
我们在 n = 18 n = 18 n = 18 对每个属性上测量颜色(出处)和位置(结构)的交接时间,每个属性使用与Janus-Pro 相同的累积前缀交叉即时活化补丁.
捐赠者激活被移植到一个接收器中,运行在T = 9216 T = 9216图像符上一个不断增长的前缀 [0, K [0, K], 我们记录了(对捐赠者的) 覆被率相对于 K K (图 10 ) 。
结构在出现前就承诺。
位置以3,072个令牌(占序列的33%)达到50%的翻转率,并在那里饱和. 颜色以4,608个令牌(序列的一半)达到50%,饱和度以75%覆盖.
在每个前缀长度上,位置的翻转率至少会和颜色一样高. 相换边距为位置约0.10-0.15,颜色约0.03-0.06.

blocks.en:
A methodological observation makes this comparison meaningful.
When we instead steer with a single global direction, adding α ​ ∥ h ∥ ​ d ^ \alpha\lVert h\rVert\hat{d} to every step as in a linear ITI-style edit, appearance is still overridable.
The override appears only late , once the injection covers essentially the whole sequence.
Structure, in contrast, is not overridable at all: a global push toward “swap left/right” or “add an object” does not rearrange the layout or change the count; it simply collapses the image.
A uniform direction cannot perform a position-dependent rearrangement.
Structure is therefore rigid to a global edit and yields only under a faithful transplant of the donor’s actual early activations.
We consequently report the color-vs-position cross05 comparison under the same method (patching) for both attributes, so the ordering is not an artifact of mixing interventions.
Across three architecturally distinct AR generators, the same ordering holds: structure is written into the sequence earlier than appearance.
On LlamaGen and Lumina-mGPT 2.0, this evidence covers the commit order only, not where the support concentrates.
blocks.zh:

blocks.en: A.7 LOCUS implementation details (main paper §3.3)
blocks.zh: A.7 LOCUS 实施细节(主要文件第3.3节)

blocks.en:
This subsection reports the optimizer, sampling, and reward settings shared by every repair arm in main-paper §4.
We optimize the selected image-token hidden states with REINFORCE, using the reward minus the target baseline as the advantage. We use Adam with a learning rate of 0.03 and a classifier-free guidance weight of 5.0.
Each repair round draws 16 candidate rollouts.
Base generations and rollouts use multinomial sampling for all 576 image tokens at a temperature of 1.0, with a fixed seed per prompt.
A rollout therefore differs from its base generation only through the optimized window, where the token is the argmax of the optimized latent.
This design makes every arm a paired comparison against the same base image.
Each round then runs up to 6 inner optimization steps with early stopping, including the main results and the matched-window controls of main-paper §4.3.
The inner reward is a GPT-4.1 per-dimension partial-credit score; the outer verifier is GPT-4.1 (re-scored by Qwen3.5-9B in § A.6 ).
All runs use a single NVIDIA A100 GPU.
Optimizer and sampling settings follow MILR [ 36 ] , and the prefix arm corresponds to MILR.

blocks.en: A.8 A capability hierarchy of attribute control
blocks.zh: A.8. 联合国 属性控制的能力等级

blocks.en:
Our findings organize attribute control into nested levels, each demanding more than the last (Figure 12 ): readable ⊋ \supsetneq donor-patchable ⊋ \supsetneq trajectory-wide fixed-direction controllable ⊋ \supsetneq prefix fixed-direction controllable.
The outer levels are readable (probe/SAE) and donor-patchable (all attributes, given an oracle donor and sufficient sequence coverage).
Trajectory-wide fixed-direction control holds for color, which is local, redundant, and re-decidable token-by-token, so a single global direction applied across the trajectory can recolor without disturbing geometry.
Prefix fixed-direction steering mainly amplifies attributes that the prompt already requests (main paper §3.2).
Size, material, and count demand coordinated, position-dependent structural change that no single global direction can produce, which is why they fall out of the fixed-direction level entirely.
This separation tracks the information-flow account of main-paper §3.3: a global geometric constraint is fixed early and cannot be locally rewritten, while a locally re-read appearance stays malleable across the trajectory.
This account explains why representation-engineering steering succeeds only narrowly and why support-matched, reward-guided optimization is needed for the remaining attributes.

我们的发现将属性控制组织成嵌入层(图12),每层要求超过上层(图12):可读 \ supsetneq 捐助方- patchable \ supsetneq 轨迹全程可固定方向控制 \\\ supsetneq 前缀可固定方向控制 。
外部水平是可读的(probe/SAE)和可捐赠的(所有属性,给一个甲骨文捐赠者和足够的序列覆盖).
轨迹全长的固定方向控制为颜色所持有,它是局部的,冗余的,并且逐个地被重新确定,因此跨轨应用的单一全球方向可以在不扰动几何的情况下被重新显示.
前缀的固定方向向导主要会放大提示已经请求的属性(主纸§3.2).
大小、物质和计数需求协调、位置依赖的结构变化,没有一个单一的全球方向能够产生,这就是它们完全脱离固定方向的原因。
这种分离跟踪了正文§3.3的信息流账户:一个全局几何约束被提前固定,无法被本地重写,而本地重读的外观则会保持可商可穿越轨道.
这一说法解释了为什么代表-工程指导的成功范围很小,以及为什么其余属性需要支持与奖励相匹配、有指导的优化。

blocks.en: A.9 Limitations
blocks.zh: A.9 限制

blocks.en:
These limitations bound the scope of the claims.
First, several mechanism experiments use a single layer ( L = 0 L{=}0 ) and modest sample sizes for some attributes.
Second, appearance and structure use different evaluators (CLIP vs. detectors).
We mitigate this evaluator mismatch with within-class window profiles, a per-claim evaluator label, and a unified-VLM sanity check that reproduces the structure-early/appearance-late ordering (Table 10 ), but do not fully remove it.
Third, the cross-model evidence covers commit order only: on LlamaGen-XL and Lumina-mGPT 2.0 we measure cumulative-prefix curves, not the band-resolved or two-dimensional support.
Fourth, content gating uses a fixed threshold; we have not characterized sensitivity across thresholds such as 0.90, 0.92, and 0.95.
The necessary condition is scoped to test-time image-token latent interventions under a fixed model, reward, and budget, not to weight-level edits or arbitrary budgets.
blocks.zh:
这些限制限制了索赔的范围。
首先,一些机制实验使用单层(L = 0 L{=}0)和适度的样本大小来表示一些属性.
第二,外观和结构使用不同的评价器(CLIP与探测器).
我们减少这种评价员与类内窗口配置、每索赔评价员的标签以及统一VLM的正常度检查不匹配的情况,这些检查复制了结构早期/出现后期命令(表10),但不完全删除。
第三,跨模型证据只涵盖承诺令:在LlamaGen-XL和Lumina-mGPT 2.0上,我们测量的是累积前缀曲线,而不是波段解析后或二维支持.
第四,内容显示使用固定阈值;我们没有说明跨越阈值的敏感性,如0.90、0.92和0.95。
必要条件的范围是,在固定模式、奖励和预算下测试时间、图像存储的潜在干预,而不是加权编辑或任意预算。
